import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df1, df2, features=["feature1", "feature2", "feature3"], target="target"):
    # Merge dataframes on the 'id' column
    merged_df = pd.merge(df1, df2, on="id", how="inner")

    # Keep only the needed columns and drop rows with missing values
    required_cols = list(features) + [target]
    data = merged_df.dropna(subset=required_cols)

    # Prepare feature matrix and target vector
    X = data[features]
    y = data[target]

    # Fit linear regression model
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)

    # Predictions and residuals
    predicted_values = model.predict(X)
    residuals = y - predicted_values

    # Plot residuals
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(predicted_values, residuals)
    ax.axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=1)
    ax.set_title("Residuals Plot")
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted Values")
    ax.set_ylabel("Residuals")

    return {
        "coefficients": model.coef_.tolist(),
        "intercept": float(model.intercept_),
        "residuals_plot": ax,
    }
